title: A Petition for the Captives
english: We are your people of faith; even though we are unworthy of your philanthropy, nevertheless we are sheep of your Church, gathered together as one. This entreaty we bring to you, the poor, on behalf of a multitude of people in captivity; priests and peoples, youths and [text ends] approach in your three-day resurrection.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in Christi resurrectionem u02-rem-early

title: A Prayer for All Believers
english: Virgins, elders with the younger, infants with mothers, every soul of those believing in you: [may you] redeem them all from every looming threat, and make them worthy of your kingdom, through the grace and the love for mankind of your only-begotten Son and Lord God.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in Christi resurrectionem u02-rem-mid

title: Doxology to the Trinity
english: And of our Savior Jesus Christ, with his all-holy and life-giving Spirit; now and always and unto the ages of the ages. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in Christi resurrectionem u02-rem-close
